name: primitives-texts-highlight
blurb: Text glows with a highlight that pulses behind it.
description: Renders text with a backdrop glow or highlight that animates in and out, emphasizing key words.
use_when: Accent words or phrases within body copy that deserve visual pop.
avoid_when: Full headings — a highlight every few words becomes chaotic.
a11y: Text is readable. Animation is decorative with no interaction barrier.
